fixture_and_review_disclosures: Nine old safety-contract expectations deliberately revised (Core 1, Pro 8), with complete baseline test snapshots and exact before/after assertions disclosed; no unchanged-assertion claim for those cases.

Public upgrade's three cases are working-draft failures; previous broad review wording is explicitly corrected. They cover one branch cause and are not added to the 14 historical public behavior failures.
Thirteen complete snapshots: 10 exact fixed-baseline blobs and 3 working-draft modules. Replaying a complete old module with current dependencies is not a full historical checkout.
Pro author reviews of own changes are labeled as author reproducibility checks. Root/runtime non-author Pro review and Pro/Core non-author Core review are separately identified.

safety.new_controller_acceptance: Filesystem/API/SQLite routing with explicit OS, package, GPU and provider spies; no live controller restart or real host process scan/signal.
safety.original_workspace: Separate feature worktrees only; original dirty workspace preserved, count checked separately, not a content hash.
safety.holdout: Only hash checked; plaintext not read.

limits: C2e1 is safety refusal only, not completed V1, positive stop ACK, resumed research or cross-controller/restart recovery.
C2e2 must bind controller registration, exact request, all admitted work and proven closure before restart/resume/reallocation can finish.
StopOutcome.confirmed is a reserved display label, not authority; marker absence permits only other admission checks.
No global filesystem atomicity, hostile same-UID sandbox, automatic process adoption, time-based takeover or authority to release another owner's GPU lease.
Uninstall, internal self-upgrade, service management and watchdog control paths are not comprehensively certified here.
No scientific validity, cross-domain CPU product loop, research efficiency, statistical independence or deployment claim.
